rationale: The plan correctly identifies the TPM-only data state and fits limma with eBayes(trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE) on log2(TPM+1), explicitly forbidding DESeq2/edgeR/voom, pseudo-count reconstruction, TMM and size factors, matching the reference; the one gap is that it never actually asks the core for the raw counts or Salmon quant directories, only notes their absence. QC (PCA/MDS, distance heatmap, detected genes, column sums, outlier flag policy), the filter (TPM>=1 in >=6 samples), the design (~condition with control as explicit reference, no blocking needed for unpaired single batch), and BH at 0.05 with TREAT for an in-model fold-change threshold are all stated concretely and fit this dataset. Enrichment was not requested but is defensibly warranted for a strong psoriasis contrast and is specified well (full ranked list, moderated t stated, tested-gene universe, 15-500 window, named collections), though the collection versions are deferred to run time rather than named. The report step covers method, versions, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, seed, and an explicit limitations paragraph.
